DEFINITION · qeva:1:order@1

Order

An order records a consistent notion of before, below, or no greater than.

editorialorder-theory · structure
Run a related experimentTrace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

An order records a consistent notion of before, below, or no greater than.

EXACT

The compact statement

A partial order ≤ is reflexive, antisymmetric, and transitive. A total order additionally compares every pair.

Example

Subset inclusion partially orders the subsets of a set.

Boundary / caveat

Not every pair is comparable in a partial order.
